filters.detection: verified only: v1 judged+confirmed positives, v1 rejected/disputed and v2.2 negative-control negatives, v3/vbeta IMPORT_AS_NEGATIVE negatives; a v2.2 positive must reach L5/L6 in the adjudicated experiment_view.level of derived_v2_2/records.jsonl (the immutable source status is not read: it still says experimentally_verified for demoted records); unverified harvest rows never positives; a v2.2 row below L5 is excluded as v2.2:detection_below_l5, never relabelled a negative
filters.severity: closed-vocab only; qa/unknown excluded, never coerced

held_out_partitions.note: nothing is deleted: every excluded row is written there with its provenance intact. The directory is outside training/, so a consumer globbing the training directory cannot reach it, and it is not listed in this manifest

protected_record_exclusion.rule: a record that ANY benchmark family holds out (split test or validation) is excluded from the model-visible corpus, whatever this layer's own split label says; the v3 layer's benchmark_split and the benchmark's splits_v3 disagree, so a row can sit in a train shard and still be a benchmark test row

split_policy: official splits reused (v1 splits_v2, v2.2 splits_v2_2, v3 benchmark_split, vbeta by-source assignment); V4 uses a deterministic canonical-training-only by-source assignment. THE MODEL-VISIBLE CORPUS SHIPS THE TRAIN PARTITION ONLY: the validation and test partitions of these same assignments are the evaluation partitions of the benchmark families, so shipping them inside the training corpus would ship the evaluation answers with the inputs.
